title: a-seals-closure-stops-at-its-own-component
intention: A seal's import closure records only the files the proof's own component owns, plus the proof itself, so a change to a tool a component imports no longer moves that component's seal.
why: Akien answered 2026-10-05, verbatim: "tool proofs: agreed" (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 7); the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 directed this sibling 2026-10-05, deriving it from RULE 1 and Akien's "then what files changed elsewhere doesn't matter one whit": with only the reseal door narrowed (3e80b61b7acf), a tool's edit moves every user's seal and nothing re-runs them — a red with no path to green. MEASURED 2026-10-05: 336 of 342 standing seals carry a closure naming files owned by another component, 7,543 entries in all.
how: cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py repo_relative_closure: after the repo filter, keep the proof and only those closure files whose owner (cairn.tools.base.address.component_of, the deepest component ancestor, a leaf importing only pathlib) equals the proof's owner; a proof under no component keeps the whole closure; component_of is asked only of files beside the proof, so the reader's repo_relative_closure([], proof) pays nothing. sealed_fingerprint_now is untouched: a seal is re-read under the closure it recorded, so standing seals keep their wider closures until resealed and nothing expires at once. The exact diff rides this ticket's build_patch field. One new proof, cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_a_seal_reads_only_its_own_components_files.py, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_a_seal_reads_only_its_own_components_files.py passes all four teeth: (1) a closure taken for a tester proof over a raw list naming cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py does not contain it; (2) it keeps cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and the proof; (3) a closure taken for a cairn-device proof drops cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py; (4) a seal whose recorded closure names a foreign file is re-taken over exactly that closure; and cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_store_is_a_tool.py, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_validation_store.py and test_reseal_stages_clean_seals.py stay green. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if a seal taken after the build expires when only a file another component owns changes.
watchme: none, because component_color in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py re-reads every seal on each inspector pass, and the one-shot reseal task (D5) re-measures the crossing count
children: none, because the change is one helper and one return line plus its one proof, already on disk at cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_a_seal_reads_only_its_own_components_files.py

It edits cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py only: repo_relative_closure's return passes through a new helper _owned_by_the_proofs_component.

D2: SETTLED: the proof cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_a_seal_reads_only_its_own_components_files.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 2/4 at HEAD 94334efb (2026-10-05: tooth 1 kept cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py; tooth 3 kept machines/bus/bus.py; teeth 2 and 4 green as guards). It is committed before the BUILDME crossing; D1 turns it green and does not edit it.

D3: SETTLED: after D1 run `python3 cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_a_seal_reads_only_its_own_components_files.py` (exit 0, '4 passed'), `python3 cairn/tools/validation_store/proofs/test_validation_store_is_a_tool.py` (3 passed), `PYTHONPATH=. python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_validation_store.py` and `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_stages_clean_seals.py` (each exit 0, as at HEAD). Measured so on a prototype of D1, 2026-10-05.

D4: SETTLED: commit cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py with message '184d211153ff: a seal's closure stops at its own component' and the two trailer lines 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JrhBQALF5qFBEVqQJUsXUu'. No file outside cairn/tools/validation_store changes.

D5: SETTLED: scope. Standing seals are not rewritten: a seal is never written without a run in the same act (cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py, test_no_rung_writes_a_seal_without_a_run_in_the_same_act). MEASURED 2026-10-05: 336 of 342 standing seals carry a closure naming files owned by another component (7,543 entries). Each narrows the next time it is resealed; resealing the 336 at once is a one-shot task cast after this ticket is PROVED, not this ticket's.

D6: SETTLED: the answer that sets this behaviour is Akien answered 2026-10-05, verbatim: "tool proofs: agreed" (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 7); the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 directed this sibling 2026-10-05, deriving it from RULE 1 and Akien's "then what files changed elsewhere doesn't matter one whit": with only the reseal door narrowed (3e80b61b7acf), a tool's edit moves every user's seal and nothing re-runs them — a red with no path to green. No question is opened.

diff --git a/cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py b/cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py
index eb827885..996b799e 100644
--- a/cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py
+++ b/cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py
@@ -347,7 +347,31 @@ def repo_relative_closure(files, proof_path: str) -> list[str]:
             continue
         if rel.endswith(".py"):
             out.add(rel)
-    return sorted(out)
+    return sorted(_owned_by_the_proofs_component(out, proof_path))
+
+
+def _owned_by_the_proofs_component(rels: set, proof_path: str) -> set:
+    """Keep only the closure files the proof's own component owns, and the proof itself.
+
+    AKIEN'S ANSWER, 2026-10-05 (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 7): "tool proofs:
+    agreed" — a tool's change re-runs only the tool's own proofs (ticket 3e80b61b7acf). A seal
+    whose closure still named the tool's files would expire on that change with nothing to
+    re-run it, so the closure stops at the component boundary (ticket 184d211153ff): a file
+    another component owns is that component's proofs' business (RULE 1). Measured before the
+    build: 336 of 342 standing seals named foreign files, 7,543 entries. The owner is the
+    deepest component ancestor (``component_of``), so a holder's closure drops its nested
+    machines too. Only the files BESIDE the proof are asked, so the reader's
+    ``repo_relative_closure([], proof)`` pays nothing; a proof under no component keeps the
+    whole closure rather than guessing."""
+    from cairn.tools.base.address import component_of
+    mine = os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(str(proof_path)), _REPO_ROOT)
+    others = rels - {mine}
+    if not others:
+        return rels
+    owner = component_of(os.path.join(_REPO_ROOT, mine))
+    if owner is None:
+        return rels
+    return {mine} | {r for r in others if component_of(os.path.join(_REPO_ROOT, r)) == owner}
